scope: Current-canonical admission of independently qualified F-GC24 coupled restart / split-run / replay composition

invariants.evidence: Reuses the single canonical SWAP kernel and adds no coupled special-purpose kernel.
Restart runtime remains typed and serialization-neutral; no files, formats, paths or parsing enter the kernel.
SWAP committed state, groundwater continuation, interface ledger and coupling origin remain explicit separate carriers.
Only continuation-relevant committed state crosses restart; transient tokens and scratch remain excluded.
No Newton vectors, Jacobians, constitutive intermediates or worker scratch are persisted.
No heavyweight per-column solver ownership or fixed AoS storage layout is introduced.
Restart is accepted-boundary only, requires quiescence, and recoverable failures leave local committed publication untouched.
Restore reconstructs committed physical origin only; rejected trial state is not promoted.
Accepted time is generic and no day, month, year or midnight semantics are introduced.
No fixed coupling-window duration is encoded in restart or replay.
Coupling provenance, groundwater continuation, ledger continuation and transactional publication remain explicit runtime responsibilities.
Head/flux direct-groundwater interface semantics and sign convention are unchanged.
Committed interface-ledger continuation is exact and no configurable water-mass concession is introduced.
No interface-sensitivity semantics are changed; F-GC23 whole-window tangent composition remains separate.
Restart adds no mandatory extra predictor/corrector or finite-difference coupling reruns.
Architecture remains compatible with batched MultiSWAP execution; F-GC25 scaling evidence remains separate.
No one-to-one MODFLOW-cell mapping or tile fraction is persisted in SWAP state.
No deep-vadose transfer-zone state or law is embedded in SWAP restart.
No transfer-zone storage is created or destroyed; coupled interface mass remains explicit.
Restart depends on common committed-state contracts rather than one Richards implementation.
Existing SWAP physics is reused without duplicate groundwater-specific process physics.
No HeadCalc-private arrays or numerical internals enter the restart contract.
Restart mechanics do not silently alter physical options or solver policy.
No unbounded retry or hidden recomputation path is added; bounded-cost integration remains F-GC26 scope.
Reference mode and full-accuracy solver paths remain available and unchanged.
Quiescence, provenance rejection, restart status and ledger diagnostics remain explicit and test-visible.
Restart adapter/state is opt-in and incurs cost only in coupled restart-capable compositions.
Runtime/coupler composes the groundwater exchange service and restart adapter; the SWAP kernel does not own system mapping.
No .swp, path, calendar, midnight or direct-MODFLOW assumption is introduced.
F-CI65 explicitly audits all 30 architecture invariants before admission.

hard_nonclaims: This audit does not claim groundwater-coupling-v1 completion.
F-GC20, F-GC22, F-GC23, F-GC25, F-GC26 and final F-GC27 closure remain separate obligations.
Postimage preservation is required after canonical promotion.
